description: Project scaffolding, Prisma schema with all entities, database migrations, and comprehensive seed data. This is the foundation — all other FEATs depend on the schema and seed being complete. Independent of other FEATs but must run first.
steps: Create directory structure: campus-x/, campus-x/frontend/, campus-x/backend/, campus-x/ml-service/, campus-x/database/, campus-x/docs/. Absolute root: c:\Users\poorv\OneDrive\Desktop\Projects!!\Major Project\campus-x

Create campus-x/docker-compose.yml with services: postgres (image: postgres:15, port 5432, env POSTGRES_DB=campusx, POSTGRES_USER=campusx, POSTGRES_PASSWORD=campusx123), backend (build ./backend, port 3001, depends_on postgres), frontend (build ./frontend, port 5173), ml-service (build ./ml-service, port 8001). Add named volume for postgres data.
Create campus-x/.env.example with: DATABASE_URL, JWT_SECRET, JWT_REFRESH_SECRET, PORT, FRONTEND_URL, OPENAI_API_KEY (optional), ML_SERVICE_URL

Initialize backend: `cd campus-x/backend && npm init -y`. Install prod deps: express, @prisma/client, prisma, typescript, ts-node, bcryptjs, jsonwebtoken, multer, zod, cors, helmet, morgan, dotenv, axios, csv-parse, uuid. Install dev deps: @types/express, @types/node, @types/bcryptjs, @types/jsonwebtoken, @types/multer, @types/cors, @types/morgan, @types/uuid, ts-node-dev, tsconfig-paths. Create backend/tsconfig.json with compilerOptions: target ES2020, module commonjs, strict true, esModuleInterop true, outDir ./dist, rootDir ./src, paths @/* → ./src/*. Create backend/package.json scripts: dev (ts-node-dev --respawn src/server.ts), build (tsc), start (node dist/server.js), db:migrate (prisma migrate dev), db:seed (ts-node prisma/seed.ts), db:generate (prisma generate).

Initialize frontend: `cd campus-x/frontend && npm create vite@latest . -- --template react-ts`. Install prod deps: react-router-dom, axios, @tanstack/react-query, react-hook-form, zod, @hookform/resolvers, lucide-react, recharts, tailwindcss, postcss, autoprefixer. Install dev deps: vite-tsconfig-paths, @types/react, @types/react-dom. Run `npx tailwindcss init -p`. Configure frontend/tailwind.config.ts with content paths and extend theme: colors { primary: deep blue scale, accent: teal scale }. Configure frontend/vite.config.ts with path alias @/ → src/. Create frontend/tsconfig.json with jsx react-jsx, moduleResolution bundler, paths @/* → ./src/*.

Initialize ml-service: Create campus-x/ml-service/requirements.txt with: fastapi==0.104.1, uvicorn==0.24.0, scikit-learn==1.3.2, pandas==2.1.3, numpy==1.26.2, python-multipart==0.0.6, pydantic==2.5.0. Create ml-service/Dockerfile (FROM python:3.11-slim, pip install -r requirements.txt, CMD uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8001). Create campus-x/ml-service/main.py stub with FastAPI() app and /health endpoint returning {status: ok}.

Write campus-x/backend/prisma/schema.prisma with ALL models and enums in dependency order: (1) Enums: Role (ADMIN,FACULTY,STUDENT,GUEST), RoomType (CLASSROOM,LAB,FACULTY_CABIN,OFFICE,RESTROOM,STAFF_ROOM,SEMINAR_HALL,AUDITORIUM,LIBRARY,OTHER), RoomStatus (AVAILABLE,OCCUPIED,MAINTENANCE,RESERVED,TEMP_UNAVAILABLE), DayOfWeek (MON,TUE,WED,THU,FRI,SAT), SemesterType (ODD,EVEN), ExamType (END_SEM,INTERNAL,ASSIGNMENT,LAB_MANUAL,NOTES,OTHER), ResourceStatus (PENDING,APPROVED,REJECTED), ComplaintCategory (EQUIPMENT,PROJECTOR,COMPUTER,AC,FAN_LIGHT,WATER,RESTROOM,NETWORK,CLASSROOM_DAMAGE,ELECTRICAL,OTHER), ComplaintStatus (OPEN,ASSIGNED,IN_PROGRESS,RESOLVED,CLOSED), ComplaintPriority (LOW,MEDIUM,HIGH,CRITICAL), ReservationType (SINGLE,MULTI_PERIOD,FULL_DAY,RECURRING), ReservationStatus (ACTIVE,CANCELLED,EXPIRED). (2) Models: User (id,email,password,name,role,phone,avatar,isActive,createdAt,updatedAt), Building (id,code,name,totalFloors,description,imageUrl,isActive,createdAt), Floor (id,floorNumber,name,blueprintUrl,buildingId,createdAt), Room (id,code,name,type,status,capacity,floor,floorId,buildingId,department,equipment String JSON array,accessibility,description,coordinatesX,coordinatesY,isActive,createdAt,updatedAt), Department (id,code,name,hodId nullable FK User,createdAt), Subject (id,code,name,credits,departmentId,semester Int,createdAt), Semester (id,type SemesterType,academicYear,startDate,endDate,isActive,createdAt), Class (id,name,departmentId,semesterId,semesterNumber Int,section,strength Int,createdAt), TimetableEntry (id,classId,subjectId,facultyId,roomId,semesterId,day DayOfWeek,period Int,startTime,endTime,createdAt), RoomReservation (id,roomId,reservedById,classId nullable,reason,date DateTime,periodStart Int,periodEnd Int,type ReservationType,status ReservationStatus,createdAt,updatedAt), Resource (id,title,description,subjectId nullable,departmentId,semester Int,academicYear,examType ExamType,regulation,uploadedById,fileUrl,fileName,fileSize Int,fileType,isApproved bool default false,isPublic bool default true,downloadCount Int default 0,createdAt,updatedAt), Complaint (id,autoId String unique,reporterId,category ComplaintCategory,buildingId nullable,floorId nullable,roomId nullable,description,imageUrl nullable,priority ComplaintPriority default MEDIUM,status ComplaintStatus default OPEN,assignedToId nullable FK User,resolution nullable,createdAt,updatedAt), ComplaintUpdate (id,complaintId,updatedById,message,statusChange nullable,createdAt), EnergyRecord (id,buildingId,floorId nullable,roomId nullable,date DateTime,hour Int,consumptionKwh Float,meterId nullable,isAnomaly bool default false,createdAt), AuditLog (id,userId nullable,action,entityType,entityId nullable,details Json nullable,ipAddress nullable,createdAt). All relations with proper @relation and onDelete Cascade/SetNull as appropriate.
Run migration: `cd campus-x/backend && npx prisma generate && npx prisma migrate dev --name init`. Confirm migration file created under prisma/migrations/.

Write campus-x/backend/prisma/seed.ts with ALL required seed data: (a) 5 Buildings: CSE Block (code:CSE,4 floors), Main Block (code:MAIN,3 floors), Science Block (code:SCI,3 floors), Admin Block (code:ADM,2 floors), Library Block (code:LIB,2 floors). (b) 6 Departments: CSE,ECE,Mechanical,Civil,MBA,MCA. (c) 50+ Rooms distributed across buildings — include: 20 classrooms (varied capacities 40/60/80/120), 8 labs (capacity 30-40), 10 faculty cabins, 5 offices, 6 restrooms (ladies+men per floor), 2 seminar halls, 1 auditorium, 1 library, staff rooms. For each room include: code like CSE-204, equipment JSON array, type, status AVAILABLE. (d) 55 Users: 5 admins (admin@campusx.edu admin1-5@..., password Admin@123 bcrypt hashed), 15 faculty (faculty@campusx.edu, faculty1-14@..., Faculty@123), 30 students (student1-30@campusx.edu, Student@123), 5 guests (guest@campusx.edu, guest1-4@..., Guest@123). (e) Subjects: 8 per department CSE (DBMS,OS,CN,CD,AI,TOC,SE,DS). (f) 2 Semesters: Odd 2026-27 (isActive:true, Aug 2026-Dec 2026), Even 2025-26 (isActive:false, Jan-May 2026). (g) 3 Classes: CSE Sem5 SecA (strength:54), CSE Sem3 SecA (strength:60), CSE Sem3 SecB (strength:58). (h) Full timetable entries Mon-Sat 8 periods for all 3 classes in the active semester, assigning rooms with capacity>=strength. (i) 20+ Resources: question papers 2023/2024/2025 for CSE subjects, fileUrl = /uploads/resources/sample.pdf (static placeholder), isApproved:true. (j) 10+ Complaints: mixed statuses OPEN/ASSIGNED/IN_PROGRESS/RESOLVED. (k) 30 days of EnergyRecord per building (720 records × 5 buildings = 3600 records), consumption 2.0-15.0 kWh with some anomalies flagged. Use bcryptjs with saltRounds=12 for passwords. Use upsert or deleteMany+create for idempotent re-seeding.
Run seed: `cd campus-x/backend && npm run db:seed`. Verify row counts in psql: buildings=5, rooms>=50, users=55.
acceptance_criteria: `cd campus-x/backend && npx prisma migrate status` shows all migrations applied
`cd campus-x/backend && npm run db:seed` completes without errors

psql query `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users;` returns 55
psql query `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM timetable_entries;` returns >= 48 (Mon-Sat × 8 periods × 1 class minimum)
psql query `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM energy_records;` returns >= 3600
`cd campus-x/frontend && npm run dev` starts on port 5173 (even with no pages yet — Vite default page is fine)
`cd campus-x/ml-service && uvicorn main:app --port 8001` starts and GET /health returns {status: ok}
